title: Modification of Street Wall, Setback, Lot Coverage and Maximum Horizontal Dimension Regulations
previewText:
The City Planning Commission, by special permit, may modify:

(a) the street wall requirements and minimum base heights of Section 91-31 (Street Wall Regulations);

(b) the setback requirements of Section 91-32; and

blocks.html: (1)        such modifications will result in a site plan consistent with existing scale and streetscape patterns;
